#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cstring>

const int MODULO = 1000000007;

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    int m = 2 * n;
    std::vector<std::vector<int>> f(m + 1, std::vector<int>(m + 2, 0));
    f[0][0] = 1;
    int ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
        f[i][0] = f[i - 1][1];
        for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
            f[i][j] = (f[i - 1][j - 1] + f[i - 1][j + 1]) % MODULO;
        }
        if (i % 2 == 1) {
            for (int j = 1; i + j <= m; j += 2)
                ans = (ans + f[i][j]) % MODULO;
        }
    }
    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
